proof_requests: Close-up photos of the seat cushions and backrest to check for peeling or stains.
A photo of the back of the sofa.
A photo of the underside of the sofa to check the frame.
A photo of the sofa in a well-lit room to see the full condition.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
